$description: Whole screens built from SlateOS Native. One entry per file in this folder; scripts/build-native-blocks.mjs turns them into registry items (npx slateos-native add <name>) and the docs, and the showcase previews them.

blocks.name: sign-in
blocks.title: Sign in
blocks.description: Email and password with validation, a loading state, social providers and links to sign up or reset the password.

blocks.name: sign-up
blocks.title: Sign up
blocks.description: Name, email and password with a live strength meter and a terms checkbox.

blocks.name: verify-code
blocks.title: Verify code
blocks.description: A one-time code with autofill-ready boxes, a verified state and a resend timer.

blocks.name: forgot-password
blocks.title: Forgot password
blocks.description: Ask for an email, send a reset link, then confirm where it went.

blocks.name: onboarding
blocks.title: Onboarding
blocks.description: Swipeable welcome pages with dots that follow the finger, Next and Skip.

blocks.name: dashboard
blocks.title: Dashboard
blocks.description: A collapsing title, key numbers for a week, month or year, a revenue chart and recent activity.

blocks.name: sidebar
blocks.title: Sidebar
blocks.description: An app shell with a slide-over sidebar: workspace switcher, navigation with counts, projects and the account. Swipe from the edge to open.

blocks.name: inbox
blocks.title: Inbox
blocks.description: Search, filters with counts, swipe to archive, flag or mark read, and an empty state.

blocks.name: settings
blocks.title: Settings
blocks.description: Grouped rows: account card, switches, detail rows, support, and sign out with a confirm.

blocks.name: profile
blocks.title: Profile
blocks.description: Avatar, name and bio, counts, primary actions, and tabs for activity and details.

blocks.name: paywall
blocks.title: Paywall
blocks.description: What you get, a plan picker, one clear call to action, and restore, terms and privacy links.

blocks.name: shop
blocks.title: Shop
blocks.description: Search, category chips, a featured carousel and a two-column product grid with favourites and a cart count.

blocks.name: product
blocks.title: Product
blocks.description: A photo carousel, price and rating, colour and size pickers, quantity, details that expand, and a sticky Add to cart.

blocks.name: cart
blocks.title: Cart
blocks.description: Line items with quantities, swipe to remove with undo, a promo code, the order summary and Checkout.

blocks.name: checkout
blocks.title: Checkout
blocks.description: Ship-to address, delivery speed, payment and the summary, then a confirmation with the order number.

blocks.name: grocery-list
blocks.title: Grocery list
blocks.description: A list by aisle with progress, quick add to an aisle, checked items sinking into the basket, swipe to delete and clear checked.

blocks.name: order-tracking
blocks.title: Order tracking
blocks.description: Arrival time and progress, the courier with call and message, every step so far, and what is in the order.

blocks.name: health-summary
blocks.title: Health summary
blocks.description: Activity rings, a scrubbable steps chart, heart rate, sleep and water for a day, week or month.

blocks.name: workout
blocks.title: Workout
blocks.description: A live timer and stats, splits, pause and resume, and a summary after a confirmed finish.

blocks.name: medications
blocks.title: Medications
blocks.description: Today's doses by time of day, the week's adherence, a refill reminder and a sheet to add a medicine.

blocks.name: tasks
blocks.title: Tasks
blocks.description: Today, Upcoming and Done with counts, check to complete with Undo, swipe to snooze or delete, and a New task sheet.

blocks.name: task-detail
blocks.title: Task detail
blocks.description: An editable title, subtasks with progress, a due date and reminder, notes, activity, and delete with a confirm.

blocks.name: bills
blocks.title: Bills
blocks.description: What's due soon, upcoming bills with due badges and Pay, autopay switches, and payment history.

blocks.name: pay-bill
blocks.title: Pay bill
blocks.description: An amount with quick picks, account and date, a review step, a below-minimum warning, then a receipt to share.
